title: Class Discussion
description: NCERT Class 5 English (Marigold): 'Class Discussion'. New words, comprehension, conjunctions (although, while, or), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Class Discussion': discuss, opinion, listen, agree.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Class Discussion' mean (discuss, opinion, listen, agree); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Your own idea or view about something is your ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To talk about a topic with others is to ___ it.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: Although I disagreed, I listened politely.
We can meet today or tomorrow.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Class Discussion' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Class Discussion'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A good discussion needs us to speak AND to ___.
A good discussion needs us to speak and also to ___.

exemplars: Although I disagreed, I listened politely.
We can meet today or tomorrow.

nodes.title: Conjunctions (although, while, or)
nodes.teach_focus: Conjunctions link ideas: 'although' shows a contrast, 'while' shows two things at once, 'or' shows a choice.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses conjunctions (although, while, or) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of conjunctions (although, while, or).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the right word: 'I will read ___ you write.'
You can have tea ___ coffee. (a choice)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: Although I disagreed, I stayed calm.
We can meet today or tomorrow.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Class Discussion'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Class Discussion': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In a discussion, I always ___ to others first.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: You can have tea ___ coffee. (a choice)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: Although I disagreed, I listened politely.
We can meet today or tomorrow.

You can have tea ___ coffee. (a choice)
